title: Smoky Chickpea Indian Dish
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired dish made with smoky spices, chickpeas, and chana masala. Serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for 1 minute.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add chana masala and smoky spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and stir to combine.
Add garam masala and salt. Stir to combine.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
Serve over basmati rice or with naan bread.
